parameters.name: ContactGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the alert contact group.

parameters.name: GroupIds
parameters.description: The ID of the alert contact group.

parameters.name: IsDetail
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return all the alert contacts in the queried alert contact group. Valid values:

*   `false`
*   `true`

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of alert contact groups displayed on each page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms describe-contact-groups --contact-group-name TestGroup --page 1 --size 20 --is-detail true --group-ids 12345 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms DescribeContactGroups --region cn-hangzhou --GroupIds 12345 --ContactGroupName TestGroup --Size 20 --Page 1 --IsDetail true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
